title: Defuse the Bomb
summary: Given a circular array code of length n and an integer key k, replace each number in the array according to the following rules: if k > 0, replace the ith number with the sum of the next k numbers; if k < 0, replace the ith number with the sum of the previous -k numbers; if k == 0, replace the ith number with 0.
statement: Given a circular array code of length n and an integer key k, replace each number in the array according to the following rules: if k > 0, replace the ith number with the sum of the next k numbers; if k < 0, replace the ith number with the sum of the previous -k numbers; if k == 0, replace the ith number with 0. Note that the array is circular, so the next element of code[n-1] is code[0], and the previous element of code[0] is code[n-1]. Return the decrypted array to defuse the bomb.
constraints: Replace each position by the next k values when k>0, previous -k values when k<0, or zero when k=0; indexing is circular.
hints: A doubled array turns circular neighbors into contiguous slices.
Choose the forward or backward slice around each original index.
For k>0 sum i+1 through i+k; for k<0 sum i+n+k through i+n-1; return zeros for k=0.
Doubling preserves cyclic order for every window shorter than n.
editorial: Doubling preserves cyclic order for every window shorter than n.

tests.explanation: Each output sums the other three circular values.
Each output sums its two preceding circular values.
